items.t: Why Is Delta Air Lines (DAL) Fighting Heathrow’s Planned 2028 Terminal Move?
items.sum: Delta Air Lines (NYSE: DAL) and Virgin Atlantic are opposing London Heathrow Airport's plan to relocate Delta to a new terminal from 2028. Both airlines are preparing legal and regulatory challenges to Heathrow's decision, according to their current public stance. The proposed terminal move would affect Delta's transatlantic hub operations with Virgin Atlantic at one of Europe's busiest airports.
